description: Wide verify HC fusion. In the C16 odd-width and C32 maximum allocation fixtures with the wide_verify option, each verify step of 65 or 192 rows runs 77 of each rank's 80 HC boundaries as the column-block producer with the deferred all-reduce round and the split finish that a 64-row step launches, in place of the rounding, F32 expansion, one-CTA mixer, row norm, widening and input quantizer launches. The three standalone mixers per rank and step keep their entries. Existing allocations, handles, modules and resolves, and every other journal, create and history, are identical.
